title: 'Being a ballet dancer is years of hard work, but it's all worth it': Kadeem En Pointe
summary: A male ballet dancer has spoken to FRANCE 24 about his love for ballet and his aim to encourage more men to dance en pointe. The art of dancing on the tip of your toes is usually seen as a musical box-style female role, but Kadeem En Pointe has trained himself to be able to do it as well.
